[[The Floodplain of Mahnkelon]] | henchman = y | merchant = y | storage = y | pic1 = [[Image:Rilohn Refuge world map.jpg|196px]] | pic1-text = On the world map | pic2 = [[Image:Moddok Crevice inside.jpg|196px]] | pic2-text = A view inside }} '''Moddok Crevice''' is a hidden smuggler camp at the entrance of a secret underground route connecting [[Kourna]] and [[Vabbi]]. {{Quotation|game| A smuggler's camp hidden behind the [[Mahnkelon Waterworks]], the Crevice is for those who don't want to be found, those who aren't looking, and those who just want to be left alone. Residents keep to themselves and strongly suggest that you do the same. }} ==Getting there== Completion of either the [[Pogahn Passage]] or [[Rilohn Refuge]] mission will bring your character here and is the only method to unlock this outpost. The gate in [[The Floodplain of Mahnkelon]] is closed until completion of either of those missions. ==Exits== *[[Bahdok Caverns]] (north, by talking to [[Gatekeeper Kahno]]; completion of mission required) *[[The Floodplain of Mahnkelon]] (southwest) ==NPCs== ===Allies=== ====Services==== *{{x}} 20 [[Raleva]] ([[merchant]]) *{{x}} 15 [[Xunlai Agent]] ([[storage upgrades]]) *{{x}} 24 [[Xunlai Chest]] ([[storage]]) =====Henchmen===== :''(all level 20)'' *{{w}} [[Devona]] (Fighter) *{{r}} [[Aidan]] (Archer) *{{mo}} [[Kihm]] (Healer) *{{mo}} [[Mhenlo]] (Healer) *{{n}} [[Eve]] (Blood) *{{me}} [[Odurra]] (Illusion) *{{e}} [[Cynn]] (Fire) *{{e}} [[Herta]] (Earth) *{{p}} [[Sogolon]] (Motivation) *{{d}} [[Gehraz]] (Holy) ====Other allies==== *{{x}} 16 [[Unlucky Simon]] (mission starter) *{{x}} 15 [[Gatekeeper Kahno]] *{{x}} 20 [[Hagon]] (mission briefing) *{{x}} 10 [[Kournan Noble]]s *{{x}} 10 [[Kournan Peasant]]s *{{x}} 2 [[Kournan Child]]ren == Notes == * Direct exploration of this outpost does not contribute towards the [[Cartographer]] title; the game considers it to be underground. Nevertheless, you can uncover nearly all of its visible surface area by carefully scraping [[The Floodplain of Mahnkelon]]. * If you run to here through the desolation or hire a runner, you can start the mission after completing [[To Kill a Demon]] or [[No Me, No Kormir]] and skip [[Rilohn Refuge]] or [[Pogahn Passage]]. This will make the rest of the Nightfall campain [[Guide to Vabbi tour|noticably shorter]]. == Trivia == * If your graphics card does not meet the game's minimum requirement of 64 MB of memory, this outpost is probably as far as you can progress in [[Nightfall]]; attempts to enter other explorable areas or zones will result in an error and/or an application crash. {{Towns and outposts in Kourna}}
